defects.title: Make the remaining scholarship navigation link canonical
defects.body: Premise: `app/page.tsx:347` keeps the visible primary-navigation scholarship link at `#solicitar`, while the same release establishes `/solicitar-bolsa` as the canonical scholarship journey and requires every scholarship action/owned landing link to use it. → Path: a visitor chooses "Solicitar bolsa" from the primary navigation; the browser only scrolls to the landing-page band instead of opening the scholarship application. → Verdict: the navigation path fails the canonical-route contract, and it remains a divergent scholarship entry point. Change this href to `/solicitar-bolsa`; the footer's same navigation link at line 567 should follow the same invariant.
defects.suggestion: Point both visible `Solicitar bolsa` navigation links directly to `/solicitar-bolsa` and add a DOM-level regression assertion for their hrefs.
evidence: Premise: app/page.tsx:347 uses `#solicitar` for the visible primary-navigation scholarship link and app/page.tsx:567 repeats it in footer navigation. → Path: selecting either labeled `Solicitar bolsa` link only navigates to the landing-page fragment. → Verdict: it bypasses the required canonical `/solicitar-bolsa` scholarship route.

Premise: task_04.md:27-30,108-109,120,133 requires owned landing links and every scholarship action to use `/solicitar-bolsa`. → Path: the donor-first route migration changed the neighboring app/page.tsx navigation hunk while preserving `#solicitar`. → Verdict: the changed public-navigation surface is not consistently migrated to the canonical route.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat can reach an admin configuration URL despite the hidden sidebar section
suppressions.note: The page's initial data call is `getSchoolYears`, and app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:332 first invokes the centralized Admin guard. The parallel header, templates, and contract pages call similarly guarded data actions, so the server boundary denies their data/action path rather than relying on hidden navigation.

suppressions.candidate: Student upload categories use a different naming convention than UI fields
suppressions.note: The UI emits `rg_aluno_${i}` and `certidao_nascimento_${i}` (step-2-students.tsx:190,202); the allowlist and submission category validation use exactly those patterns (form-actions.ts:37,55-56).

suppressions.candidate: The shared seal might differ from the approved asset
suppressions.note: `SealLogo` is the sole web-seal component and references `/seal-arca.svg`; `cmp -s public/seal-arca.svg docs/design/opendesign/assets/seal-arca-master.svg` succeeded, and active public/admin consumers use `SealLogo`.
